directional_development_vetoes.historical_calibration: B5-ARM1-LINGALA-SENTINEL-2026-001 detected the Arm-1 Lingala regression under EXACTLY this rule: base_lingala_wer 0.172301 vs step-0014000 0.1793 (delta_abs_wer 0.006999), noninferiority upper_ci 0.012685598962087357 > margin 0.01 -> verdict PRESERVATION_GATE_FAILURE_CONFIRMED. Since 0.012685 > 0.01, a candidate reproducing that behaviour is VETOED. (The rev-003 '95% lower bound > +2.0pp' veto would NOT have fired.)
directional_development_vetoes.nature: HARD VETO, never a positive gate. These languages have NO untouched data (already-seen surfaces), so a good score CANNOT confirm preservation; but a GROSS regression is still disqualifying.
directional_development_vetoes.not_a_gate: passing the veto is NOT evidence of preservation for these languages (seen data); that requires Phase-B base-blind data. The veto only DISQUALIFIES regression.
directional_development_vetoes.veto_rule: a candidate is VETOED (removed from nomination, even if it passes english/french/swahili/pidgin) iff it FAILS non-inferiority on the language's directional surface: the one-sided 95% UPPER CI bound of (WER_candidate - reference) > 0.01 (1.0 absolute WER point), cluster bootstrap by audio_checksum_sha256 (row-level; these pools have placeholder speakers), B >= 10000. This is the SAME predeclared rule that detected the historical Lingala regression — NOT the rev-003 +2.0pp lower-bound floor, which was too weak to catch it.

constraints.kd_attribution: each candidate is compared DIRECTLY to the matched KD_CONTROL at identical budget/seed/data-order; a candidate must beat the control on the preservation macro to credit any gain to KD

pidgin_retention.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_arm1) <= +0.005 (0.5pp), after multiplicity correction

preservation_non_inferiority.reference: the frozen base teacher's per-language WER on the SAME rows
preservation_non_inferiority.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_base) <= +0.005 (0.5pp) per gated language, after multiplicity correction

statistical_procedure.H0_comparator_only: H0 (mechanics-proven anchor) can NEVER be nominated; candidates must beat it, else NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES
statistical_procedure.NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES: an explicit terminal state at either stage; the procedure NEVER silently nominates the least-bad recipe
statistical_procedure.constraints_ref: the positive qualification tests + safety vetoes are defined executably in positive_qualification_tests and safety_vetoes below (and summarized in `constraints`).
statistical_procedure.executable_gate: scripts/arm2_holm.py: Stage-1 uses candidate_qualifies(family_pvalues, candidate_indices) — Holm over the COMPLETE 24-test family, then the candidate qualifies iff ALL its 6 INDEXED tests are rejected in that full-family mask; Stage-2 uses qualifies() (the finalist's 6 tests ARE the whole family). Adversarially tested (tests/test_arm2_holm.py: the 24x p=0.04 -> 0 rejections counterexample; full-family-vs-six correction; mixed-candidate; malformed-input validation).
statistical_procedure.metric: WER = sum(edit_distance)/sum(reference_words) per language, from per-row edit-distance receipts; absolute WER points (pp)

multiplicity.stage_1: Holm-Bonferroni over the POSITIVE family = {4 candidates x (3 preservation non-inferiority + pidgin retention + beat-KD_CONTROL + beat-H0) = 24 tests}, family-wise alpha=0.05. The 3 directional vetoes per candidate are SEPARATE (safety_vetoes; not Holm-corrected).
multiplicity.stage_2: Holm-Bonferroni over the SMALLER POSITIVE family = {1 finalist x (3 preservation + pidgin retention + beat-KD_CONTROL + beat-H0) = 6 tests}, family-wise alpha=0.05, NOT re-corrected against Stage-1. Vetoes remain separate/raw.

beat_H0.pass: DESCRIPTIVE per-test summary: lower_CI95 > 0 (== raw p <= 0.05). NOT the gate — see positive_gate.
beat_H0.statistic: red_b = macroWER_H0,b - macroWER_cand,b on the preservation macro

beat_KD_CONTROL.pass: DESCRIPTIVE per-test summary: lower_CI95 > 0 (== raw p <= 0.05). NOT the gate — see positive_gate.
beat_KD_CONTROL.statistic: red_b = macroWER_KD_CONTROL,b - macroWER_cand,b on the preservation macro

positive_qualification_tests.note: these MUST pass for a candidate to qualify; Holm-Bonferroni is applied over THIS family ONLY (per stage). Vetoes are NOT in this family.

pidgin_retention.pass: DESCRIPTIVE per-test summary: upper_CI95 <= 0.005 (== raw p <= 0.05). NOT the gate — see positive_gate.

positive_qualification_tests.positive_gate: HOLM REJECTION IS THE SOLE positive-qualification decision (executable: scripts/arm2_holm.qualifies). Collect the family's one-sided bootstrap p-values, sort ascending p(1)<=...<=p(m), reject the rank-j test iff p(i) <= 0.05/(m-i+1) for ALL i<=j; a candidate QUALIFIES iff EVERY one of its positive tests is Holm-rejected at FWER 0.05. The per-test raw 95% CI (above) is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY and equals the raw unadjusted p<=0.05 decision — it is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT and is NEVER the gate. Raw-CI success is NOT Holm significance for any m>1: e.g. 24 tests each with raw p=0.04 all pass the raw rule but Holm rejects NONE (0.04 > 0.05/24). If a bound must express the gate it must be the multiplicity-adjusted level 1 - 0.05/(m-j+1) for the rank-j test, not a flat 95%.

preservation_non_inferiority.pass: DESCRIPTIVE per-test summary: upper_CI95 <= 0.005 (== raw p <= 0.05). NOT the gate — see positive_gate.
preservation_non_inferiority.statistic: diff_b = WER_cand,b - WER_base,b per paired bootstrap resample b

statistical_procedure.preservation_macro: unweighted mean WER over {english, french, swahili} (SEPARATE from pidgin retention)
statistical_procedure.resampling: cluster bootstrap, B >= 10000, paired (same resampled clusters across compared arms). Cluster unit = SPEAKER, except placeholder/single-speaker pools (ewe soreva, and the directional lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe surfaces) which cluster by audio_checksum_sha256 (row-level), matching the historical lingala sentinel

safety_vetoes.not_positive: passing a veto is NOT a positive qualification and confers no credit; it only removes a gross regressor on already-seen data.
safety_vetoes.note: SEPARATE from the Holm positive family. Safety vetoes are conservative and are NOT relaxed by multiplicity (correcting them would reduce sensitivity and could miss a real regression like the historical Lingala one). Each is evaluated on its RAW per-language one-sided 95% upper CI.
safety_vetoes.statistic: diff_b = WER_cand,b - reference_b (lingala vs base; kinyarwanda/ewe vs arm1) per paired resample b, cluster unit = audio_checksum_sha256 (placeholder-speaker pools)
safety_vetoes.veto: VETO (disqualify) iff upper_CI95 > 0.01 (RAW, NOT Holm-adjusted). Replicates B5-ARM1-LINGALA-SENTINEL-2026-001 (historical upper_ci 0.012685 > 0.01).

statistical_procedure.single_authority: This is the ONE authoritative statistical procedure; no other selection logic applies. It replaces the former separate statistics/seed_procedure/selection_rule blocks.

stage_1_provisional.no_qualifier: if no candidate qualifies at Stage 1 -> NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES (hold at H0)
stage_1_provisional.qualify: a candidate qualifies iff, under seed-1 after Stage-1 correction: preservation non-inferiority passes for english/french/swahili AND pidgin retention passes AND NO directional veto fires AND it beats KD_CONTROL on the preservation macro AND it beats H0 on the preservation macro
stage_1_provisional.runs: all 6 arms (KD_CONTROL, H0, H1-H4) trained FRESH @2000 under seed 1; scored once on the frozen nomination split
stage_1_provisional.tie_break_seed1_only: the PROVISIONAL finalist = among Stage-1 qualifiers, DETERMINISTIC on SEED-1 RESULTS ONLY (seed-2 does not exist yet and is NEVER used for ranking): (1) lowest seed-1 preservation macro WER; (2) ties -> lowest KD alpha; (3) ties -> lexicographically smallest recipe id

stage_2_replication.confirm: the finalist is the FINAL nomination iff NO seed reversal occurs (see reversal_definition): all 6 positive tests Holm-rejected at Stage-2 (fresh Holm, FWER 0.05, NOT re-corrected against Stage-1) AND no veto fires. The two seeds combine CONJUNCTIVELY (AND) — both stages must independently pass; seeds are NEVER pooled into one bootstrap, and ranking/tie-break uses seed-1 only. ANY reversal (or Stage-1 no qualifier) -> NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES; NO fallback to a Stage-1 runner-up.
stage_2_replication.reversal_definition: REVERSAL = seed-2 evidence overturns any component of the Stage-1 qualification: (a) POSITIVE reversal = any positive test Holm-rejected at Stage-1 is NOT Holm-rejected at Stage-2 (in the fresh 6-test finalist family, FWER 0.05); OR (b) SAFETY reversal = any directional veto that did NOT fire at Stage-1 FIRES at Stage-2 (raw upper_CI95 > 0.01). NO SEED REVERSAL <=> neither (a) nor (b) <=> at Stage-2 the finalist has ALL 6 positive tests Holm-rejected AND fires NO veto.
stage_2_replication.runs: ONLY the provisional finalist + H0 + KD_CONTROL trained FRESH @2000 under seed 2; re-scored on the SAME frozen nomination split

terminology.confirmation: reserved for the base-blind Phase B on newly-acquired untouched data + the sealed holdout; HELD.
terminology.held_out_development_nomination: Phase A scores candidates on HELD-OUT DEVELOPMENT remainders. For english/french/swahili the base model has already been scored on these pools, so they are candidate-blind but NOT base-blind: this is NOMINATION, not confirmation.

training.matched: identical MEDZEN_SEED AND identical data ordering across all six arms

second_seed.resolves_contradiction: H0 is the comparator every candidate must beat, so H0 MUST have both seeds for a balanced paired comparison ACROSS THE TWO SEEDS; the second seed re-runs the finalist AND H0 AND KD_CONTROL (base_teacher and arm1 are seed-independent fixed checkpoints).
